name: Better Entity Reference Demo
description: Proof that the Better Entity Reference popover JS API is usable and extendable: a custom popover picker page, a demo field type/widget/formatter, and a live extension of the shipped upload widgets.
project_description: A submodule of Better Entity Reference that demonstrates its public JavaScript API (Drupal.berUI + Drupal.berTags). It provides a demo page at /better-entity-reference/demo that composes a whole popover picker from the shared kit, registers a new component type, subclasses the core Container class, and listens for ber-ui:build events to extend the shipped File/Image/Media widgets. It also ships a self-contained custom field (ber_demo_fruit) with a picker widget (ber_demo_picker), an element-based picker (DemoElementPickerWidget) and an emoji-tag formatter (ber_demo_fruit), and on install adds a Demo fruit field to a 'test' content type when one exists. Intended as reference code for third-party integrators, not for production.
